name: council-clusterfuzzlite-jazzer
description: Standalone manifest whose only purpose is to pin the ClusterFuzzLite fuzz engine to exactly @jazzer.js/core 2.1.0 and, via the committed package-lock.json alongside it, give build.sh an integrity-verified `npm ci` install. Pinned to 2.1.0 for glibc-2.31 (OSS-Fuzz base image) compatibility — see ../README.md and ../build.sh. Not part of the pnpm workspace (packages/*) and never published.
